scope_of_deliverables.quote: The selected Proponent will work with BCER’s Digital Services and Data Platform teams to design and implement a replacement for the existing Oracle APEX-based CSV download functionality. The new solution will integrate with TIBCO Data Virtualization (TDV) web services to retrieve datasets in JSON and XML formats and allow dynamic export into structured formats like CSV and Excel.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Design and implement a replacement for the existing Oracle APEX-based CSV download functionality, integrating with TIBCO Data Virtualization (TDV) web services to retrieve datasets in JSON/XML and allow dynamic export to CSV/Excel, including review of existing functionality, front-end widget development, backend transformation logic, testing/validation, alignment with accessibility/performance/security standards, packaging for deployment, and knowledge transfer/documentation.

With all pages consecutively numbered, the proposals should contain the following parts: a) Table of contents with page numbers. b) Executive summary. c) The body of the proposal in accordance with the above content requirements, to a maximum length of 12 pages.

vendor_experience_required.quote:
Proponents should demonstrate expertise in the following areas: 
• 
Experience with TIBCO Data Virtualization, similar data virtualization platforms or extensive experience with REST and SOAP webservices. 
• 
Handling and transformation of JSON and XML data structures 
• 
Front-end and back-end development experience (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Node.js, or similar) 
• 
Experience delivering secure, accessible, and performant public-facing digital services 
• 
Public sector or open data platform experience is an asset
vendor_experience_required.value: Expertise in TIBCO Data Virtualization (or similar platforms) or REST/SOAP webservices; JSON/XML transformation; front-end/back-end development (JavaScript, Python, Node.js, or similar); secure, accessible, performant public-facing digital services. Public sector/open data platform experience is an asset. No minimum years stated.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote:
The top ranking (to a maximum of three) Proponents may be asked to attend an interview with the evaluation team. 
During the interview, the evaluation committee may clarify and/or verify statements made in the written Response. 
The requirement for interviews is optional.  The BCER reserves the right to complete the evaluation process without Proponent interviews.  Interview scoring criteria will be shared with interviewees prior to an interview if they are scheduled.
